<h3 class="mobileonly">'''About'''</h3>[[Image:Logo.png|260px]]</div>A catastrophic event has occurred that summoned countless threats in multiple worlds... but it also brought all the heroes together, and they need your help! 😱Can you summon the strongest heroes and save these worlds together?<br>
<br/>
[https://www.roblox.com/games/8304191830 Anime Adventures] is a tower defense game made by [https://www.roblox.com/groups/10611639 Gomu]. It was created on December 21, 2021 and officially released on July 3, 2022. Team up with others to beat ascending levels, or do it yourself and triumph above the strongest of enemies. Players gain [[Currencies|Gems]] from beating [[Story]] and Infinite modes which can be used to [[summon]] more [[Unit List|characters]], or to buy [[items]] from the Travelling Merchant Shop. Level up your characters by beating Story and Infinite mode or using [[Items#XP_Food|XP Food]] to make them stronger!</div>
